what: Every Kev card rated YES by the Claude rater (pilot and larger test), compared by title with the case titles that already have an approved point on the service (stale/data/<platform>.json, pulled 2026-11-12). Exploratory, after scoring.
checker: one Claude Opus subagent, 2026-11-16 ~07:38-07:44 UTC, reading only items.json (id, service, suggested case; shuffled, test not shown) and approved_cases.json; titles only, no documents

categories.VARIANT: an approved case on the service makes essentially the same claim (rewording, narrower or broader, near-synonym, older or newer version)
categories.CLOSE: an approved case overlaps clearly but makes a distinguishably different claim
categories.NONE: no approved case on the service states anything close
